summary: Tested real credential login, workspace loading, authenticated WebSocket state, WebRTC voice state/mute/leave, logout, mobile smoke, API health/status, and auth/workspace persistence regression. Core browser login and voice flows passed, but community creation has a 500 ObjectId serialization error and recovery verification is missing.

critical.issue: Returns 500 after inserting the community because the response includes MongoDB ObjectId (_id). Trace: FastAPI jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId.
Endpoint returns 404; /api/auth/recovery/request generates a demo code but there is no way to verify/use it.

integration_issues.issue: Backend community creation failure prevents the requested create-and-persist workspace flow. The current Workspace also has no wired create-community/create-channel, invite, report, block, role, or moderation UI actions.
No recovery form or verification flow is exposed in the frontend, matching the missing backend verification endpoint.

action_items: Exclude _id or return a sanitized community document from POST /api/communities (and audit every insert-return endpoint for the same issue).
Implement recovery-code verification and a password-reset completion flow, then expose it in Auth UI.
Wire the existing workspace action buttons to the communities/channels/invites/reports/block/moderation/role/audit APIs.
Require a valid access token before accepting /api/ws/{room}; current server accepts anonymous WebSocket connections.
Consider refresh-token rotation/revocation: /api/auth/refresh issues a new session without revoking the old refresh token.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py returns raw inserted community/channel/report documents in several handlers; Motor adds _id and causes serialization failures where projections are absent.
The WebSocket handler sets user=None and still accepts/broadcasts when token is absent or invalid, which does not satisfy authenticated WebSocket requirements.
App.js only implements login/register entry and local logout; requested recovery and moderation/community management workflows are not represented in the UI.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_ users/communities and recovery records through the public API; no seeded account was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real login, auth/me, seeded community/channel loading, authenticated browser WebSocket (Conectado), voice getUserMedia state, mute, leave, logout, API root/status, and mobile smoke were exercised. Re-run auth_workspace_regression after community response sanitization and recovery implementation; then test all management authorization paths.
rca of the issue: POST /api/communities constructs a clean dict, inserts it with Motor, then returns the same mutated dict; Motor adds _id, and FastAPI cannot encode it. Recovery request only stores/returns a code and no verify route exists. The UI has static action controls without handlers, so backend capability is not integrated. No APIs were mocked.
